## Silver Jubilee Batches – A Tradition of Giving Back

An important feature of JNVCKM alumni engagement is the participation of silver jubilee batches in supporting school development.

As highlighted in the presentation, respective silver jubilee batches select initiatives from the association's open initiatives and contribution programmes and support projects that benefit the school.

This tradition creates a meaningful connection between alumni milestones and institutional progress. Each batch has an opportunity to leave a lasting legacy for the students who follow.

Alumni and batches interested in contributing can explore the initiatives listed on the association website:
